Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1358
Claimant:
Adam Fowler
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
December 13, 2024
First notice of loss received for a low-speed collision in a parking lot involving the insured's vehicle and a second
vehicle. The claimant reports neck and back strain and is not represented by counsel.
January 5, 2025
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of the loss. No issues with the
policy status were found.
January 15, 2025
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact and notes the scene as
described.
February 24, 2025
Spoke with the other driver, who gave an account of the collision that matches what the claimant reported. Witness
statements were requested and are being collected.
March 1, 2025
Reviewed the photographs submitted by the claimant and the scene images. The vehicle damage is consistent with
the impact described and the reported injury fits the force of the crash.
March 7, 2025
Ran a prior claims and vehicle history search. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on record, and nothing suggests
the damage predates the policy start.
March 29, 2025
Called the claimant to take a recorded statement. The account given is the same as the one provided at first notice.
May 1, 2025
Requested medical records from the treating provider. The claimant reports ongoing neck and back pain and has
been attending regular physical therapy sessions.
June 18, 2025
Medical records show a small strain in the same area several years ago that healed fully, with no treatment since.
The claimant was asked about it and acknowledged the earlier episode.
July 14, 2025
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for a strain of this kind. Requested a treatment plan and
expected timeline from the provider to better understand the duration.
July 15, 2025
Reviewed the treatment plan with the medical reviewer, who noted the injury pattern is consistent with the collision.
Duration is bieng monitored against standard recovery guidelines.
July 18, 2025
Claimant has been contacted for an update on current symptoms and work status. File remains open pending receipt
of the updated treatment plan and witness statements.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
